holdout_policy: No protected holdout is used and no MNCDS-D3, MNCS-L5, or production claim is permitted.

measurement_policy.order: fixed implementation order; all raw samples retained
measurement_policy.workload: 25000 deterministic values under the shared contract

minimum_useful_benefit.rule: At least one candidate must reduce median wall time by 5% or more versus its same-language readable reference while all hard gates pass.

primary_metric: candidate median wall-time divided by same-language reference median wall-time
protected_evidence_policy: Candidate generation and tuning may not access any future independently held corpus.
recovery_criteria: A fresh process replay of the same complete input must produce the identical canonical output; this stateless study does not claim checkpoint recovery.
target_claim: experimental development evidence only; formal MNCS and MNCDS remain UNKNOWN
unknown_policy: Required UNKNOWN blocks promotion; optional language-specific UNKNOWN remains visible.
